profile.heroHeadline: I Bring Stories to Life Through 2D Animation.
profile.heroBio: I'm a 2D Animator and Cartoon Designer with 2+ years of experience creating cartoon characters, beautiful backgrounds, and engaging visual stories using Adobe Animate CC.
profile.heroSubBio: I turn creative ideas into engaging visual experiences through character design, background art, and 2D animation.
profile.aboutBio1: I'm Shoyen Kaiser Asif, a 2D Animator and Cartoon Designer with over two years of experience in the animation field. I received my 2D animation training at Twenty One Academy and primarily use Adobe Animate CC to create cartoon animations and animation-ready visual assets.
profile.aboutBio2: My work includes character design, 2D background illustration, storyboarding, and visual storytelling. I enjoy creating appealing cartoon worlds and helping creative ideas become engaging visual experiences.
profile.aboutBio3: I'm always interested in collaborating with clients, creators, and animation teams on exciting new projects.

projects.title: Riverside Village: 2D Cartoon Animation Sequence
projects.shortDescription: A lively 2D animated sequence featuring dynamic character movement along a scenic riverbank, animated frame-by-frame in Adobe Animate CC.
projects.productionNotes: Created at 24fps in Adobe Animate CC. Rigged character symbols with squash-and-stretch principles for fluid cartoon movement.

projects.title: Monsoon Paddy Fields & Earthen Courtyard
projects.shortDescription: Atmospheric 2D cartoon background illustration depicting a rural Bengali village during twilight with traditional earthen mud houses and river curve.
projects.productionNotes: Separated into multiple parallax layers (sky, distant foliage, courtyard foreground) for multiplane camera animation in Adobe Animate.

projects.title: Raju: Bengali Village Boy Character Turnaround
projects.shortDescription: Full 4-angle character turnaround (front, 3/4, side, back) and facial expression phoneme chart for animation production.
projects.productionNotes: Designed as a modular vector symbol puppet ready for tweening and frame-by-frame lip sync.

projects.title: The Morning Catch: 4-Panel Storyboard Sequence
projects.shortDescription: Pre-production storyboard panels outlining camera staging, pacing, and visual storytelling for an animated children’s adventure cartoon.
projects.productionNotes: Detailed camera directions, character poses, and scene pacing timings for the animation team.

projects.title: Traditional Heritage Kitchen & Interior
projects.shortDescription: Detailed indoor cartoon background illustrating an authentic rural earthen kitchen, clay oven, brass lantern, and sunlight beam.
projects.productionNotes: Designed with lighting guides and volumetric sunlight rays to enhance emotional atmosphere.
